svg.title: ThumbStall: anti-doomscrolling app for Android (mechanism drawing)
svg.desc: Blueprint mechanism drawing of ThumbStall. A thumb doomscrolls an endless feed on a phone while a feed drum spins. A foreground service polls every 900 ms; the pure-Kotlin rules engine in core/ (OpenTracker, SnoozeState, BudgetTracker, OverlayGate, PauseRules, StatsWindows) trips, a stall pawl drops into the drum and the feed brakes to a stop. A breathing pause asks Still want to scroll? and counts down from 8; the 5, 10 and 15 minute session-budget chips unlock at zero; the thumb taps Close Instagram and the sheet stamps STALLED, time reclaimed. An escalation chart shows repeat opens within an hour waiting 8, 13, 18, 23, 28 and a 30 second cap: pause = min(base + 5 s x repeats, 30 s). The AndroidManifest lists usage stats, overlay, foreground service and notifications, and INTERNET is struck through: never requested. Notes: 35 core unit tests, CI on GitHub Actions, Room with migrations, costly override with a 24 second wait, essentials allowlist, snooze, positive stats, OEM battery guide, dark mode, no accounts. Version 0.1.1, GPL-3.0.
svg.text: Anti-doomscrolling app for Android · Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · Android 8+
